authorship: M6-authored rules. Initial draft f8c9fe5 preceded raw COLD download. A traditional-spelling alias was corrected by unit QA before any external test evaluation; no COLD outcomes used for tuning.
business_approval: Existing S1 decision policy confirmed by M1. New entries and individual levels await M1 release review; no approval is fabricated.
scope: Literal abusive phrases and explicit directed threats; not a general semantic hate-speech or crisis detector.
limitations: Literal rules cannot resolve quotation, negation, context, or implicit attacks.
MEDIUM/LOW are nonblocking observation labels, not clinical judgments.
The held-out COLD labels measure broader offensiveness and are not silently relabeled as HIGH.

planned_external_evaluation.sampling: Every row; exclude only text outside the existing 1..2000-character nonblank input contract. Keep duplicate rows and account for all exclusions.
planned_external_evaluation.label_policy: Keep upstream labels unchanged; offensive=1, nonoffensive=0. No training or tuning on this split.
planned_external_evaluation.assessment: External diagnostic and comparison with the five-entry starter; not a production acceptance claim.

unit_qa_revision: Added the explicit traditional spelling for the directed phrase after unit QA exposed an OpenCC ambiguity.
